name: game-end-won
description: Victory already reached (pbd243 save 389: Sol at the victory points, End Game not pressed; the base re-posts the 'has won' prompt the next save pressed). Engine: ended + phase 'finished' + finish 'won' + winners = Sol, and the prompt is the typed game.end with end / rematch values (anyone at the table may press it). Nobody presses End Game (it would archive the fork's channels).
